item.title: Xanadu central bank raises benchmark interest rate to 6.5%
item.description: Central Bank raised benchmark rate 50bp to 6.5% due to inflation in the financial sector.

item.description: Presidential meeting with foreign delegation on regional trade and infrastructure.

item.title: Xanadu signs new regional trade facilitation agreement
item.description: Trade facilitation agreement reducing customs documentation across five member states.

item.title: Annual minimum wage review committee to convene next spring

item.description: Three-year tax reform package restructuring corporate tax brackets and VAT exemptions.
